meta.name: user-satisfaction-signals
meta.description: Interpreting implicit and explicit feedback — edits, regenerations, abandonment.

copy.tagline: 分析用户反馈信号，优化产品体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从用户编辑、重试等行为中挖掘改进方向
copy.tagline_en: Analyze user feedback signals to optimize product experience
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to mine improvement directions from user edits, retries, etc.

howto.what: Claude 能够分析用户的操作行为（如编辑、重新生成、放弃任务等），从中推断用户的满意度，并给出解读。
howto.when: 当用户与 AI 交互后留下隐式或显式反馈（如操作、评分、评论）时触发。

say.text: 用户把我的回复全改了，说明什么？
say.note: Claude 会分析编辑程度并解读为不满或需要调整。

say.text: 用户反复要求重写同一问题，怎么看？
say.note: Claude 会识别这是负面信号，表示用户不满意。

say.text: 用户没回复就离开，是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会解释沉默可能是满意或困惑，需结合其他信号。

howto.what_en: Claude can analyze user behaviors like edits, regenerations, and abandonment to infer satisfaction levels and provide interpretations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users leave implicit or explicit feedback (e.g., actions, ratings, comments) after interacting with the AI.

say_en.text: The user heavily edited my response. What does that indicate?
The user asked me to regenerate multiple times. What's the signal?
say_en.note: Claude will recognize this as a negative signal indicating user dissatisfaction.

say_en.text: The user left without replying. What could that mean?
